portal_hypertension.title: Diffuse Intense Pancreatic Uptake on 99m Tc-HYNIC-TOC SPECT/CT in a Rare Case of Diffuse Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor.
portal_hypertension.authors: Elahifard H, Samadi MH, Saberifar M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：在治疗肝硬化相关并发症期间，影像学显示弥漫性胰腺肿大并伴有多个囊性病变，最初提示自身免疫性胰腺炎或淋巴瘤。 临床提示：我们报告了一名 52 岁的肝硬化女性，表现为腹痛和体重减轻。
portal_hypertension.abstract: We report a 52-year-old woman with cirrhosis presenting with abdominal pain, and weight loss. During management of cirrhosis-related complications, imaging revealed diffuse pancreatic enlargement with multiple cystic lesions, initially suggesting autoimmune pancreatitis or lymphoma. Subsequent endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsy confirmed the diagnosis of well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor (PNET). Somatostatin receptor imaging demonstrated intense, diffuse uptake throughout pancreas (Krenning score 4) without local or distant metastases.
